summary: Verified date-only fix in Procedimientos de Anestesia > Cierre mensual (Nov 2026, 37 records). With browser TZ emulated as America/Guatemala (CDP) AND in UTC, all 37 rows show the same date as backend 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD). Cross-checked 9 patients (11 rows) against /sala-operaciones (Rudel Mauricio Álvarez 09/11/26, Rudel Mauricio Alvarez 10/11/26, Adolfo Rosales 09/11/26, Berta Maria Merlo Rivas 02/11/26, Sofia Simpson Carcamo 17/11/26, Hilda Evelia Barrera 10/11 & 16/11, Marta Alicia Marroquin 04/11 & 23/11, Carlos Eduardo Diaz-nuila 05/11) - all identical. Excel and PDF exports (API + UI download buttons) contain correct dates. Regression: patient, procedure, surgeon, institution, anesthesia type, honorario, Marcar pagado -> Pagado (opacity, pending counter 37->36) -> revert to pendiente (37) all work. Bug FIXED.
action_items: Optional/latent (same root cause, not in scope): services/api.js formatDate() is used on date-only 'YYYY-MM-DD' fields elsewhere and will show the previous day: Gastos.js (expense.due_date L758/L1150, payment.date L1166), Dashboard.js L125 (alert.due_date, DB e.g. '2026-04-02'), Pacientes.js L1483 (birth_date, DB e.g. '1985-06-15'), plus possibly HistorialPagos payment.date, CuentasCobrarOptica/CXC fecha_emision/fecha_vencimiento/pago.fecha, Caja cierre.fecha/abono.fecha, Agenda miAgenda.fecha, VentasClinica sale.fecha (verify which are date-only vs datetime). Best fix: make formatDate detect /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/ and format without timezone conversion.
critical_code_review_comments: formatDateOnly in ProcedimientosAnestesia.js duplicates formatDateDisplay in SalaOperaciones.js - move to services/api.js as shared helper (or make formatDate date-only aware) to fix the same bug app-wide.
formatDateOnly would render 'NaN/NaN/aN' if d.date ever arrived as full ISO datetime; fine today since backend always sends YYYY-MM-DD.
seed_data_creation: None. Toggled pay on Adolfo Rosales anesthesia record and reverted it to pendiente (original state restored).
